name: TSR Trenchless, Inc.
tagline: Trenchless sewer lining and pipe bursting across Southern California
about:
TSR Trenchless is a Southern California trenchless contractor that has been rehabilitating sewer and drain lines without excavation for well over a decade. Owner Robert (Bob) Biedermann first saw cured-in-place lining in the early 1990s and concluded then that it would replace dig-and-replace as the standard way to fix a sewer. The company self-performs both CIPP lining and pipe bursting and recommends whichever suits the pipe, rather than steering every job toward one method.

The crews have lined and burst hundreds of lines, from 30-foot residential laterals in 4-inch cast iron and clay to municipal mains running thousands of feet at diameters up to 36 inches, including multi-connection HOA collectors and 8-inch mains with dozens of laterals reinstated robotically from inside the pipe. TSR owns its lining, bursting, hydro-jetting and camera equipment outright, which keeps pricing competitive and lets most residential jobs start the day of the inspection and finish the same day.

Based in San Juan Capistrano, TSR serves Orange County, Los Angeles County, San Diego County, Ventura and Santa Barbara, the Inland Empire and the rest of Southern California, with local numbers for each service area. Lining work is backed by TSR's 25-year warranty.
certifications: Self-performed CIPP lining (inversion and pull-in) and HDPE pipe bursting; robotic lateral reinstatement; sewer camera inspection and hydro-jetting; residential through municipal diameters (4" to 36").

reviews.author: Jonathan T.
reviews.body: Bob and his team were extremely professional. They came out and inspected the issue and recommended we put in liner. They came out the next week and finished the work in a day. They were quick and communicative the whole process, making sure we were okay with how the stucco and concrete looked. If we have any more sewer issues I will definitely give them a call again.

reviews.author: Andrew P.
reviews.body: I contacted TSR after getting a sky-high estimate from a general plumbing company - Bob was fast, professional, personable, and he & his crew led by Boris did a fantastic job. Quite happy with their company & I wish more contractors had this level of service & honesty.

reviews.author: Ryan K.
reviews.service: Outdoor plumbing system repair, Sewer repair
reviews.body: We engaged Bob and his team at TSR for work in Santa Monica to evaluate a roughly 120-foot sewer lateral installed around 1925. The line had multiple structural issues consistent with aging infrastructure, and there was an immediate problem at the city connection that, at first glance, appeared to require excavation into city property just to correct that single section. Bob's team responded quickly and approached the situation with a trenchless sewer rehabilitation strategy that fundamentally changed the outcome. Through their technical execution and specialized methods, they were able to correct the issue at the city tie-in, restore alignment across the full 120-foot run, and install a new structural liner backed by a 20-year warranty. The net result: no excavation into city property, no need to unearth and relay 120 feet of lateral, and a fully rehabilitated line at a fraction of the cost of even limited city-side excavation. If you're dealing with legacy sewer infrastructure, especially pre-war lines, TSR understands how to solve the problem without defaulting to a backhoe.

reviews.author: Christine N.
reviews.body: Bob brings expertise and competitive pricing for the epoxy liner. His team accommodated our busy schedules and got the job done in half a day!

reviews.author: Dr. Anne
reviews.body: What a relief and pleasure to work with Bob of TSR Trenchless. I wish I had found him years ago. This was a major project and he made it look effortless. Consideration was given to our plants and the entire process explained professionally. His workers were efficient, tidy, and made sure our home was left in excellent condition. I highly recommend TSR.

reviews.author: Kylie
reviews.body: Almost a year ago we bought a house in Corona and our exterior drain lines were backed up causing water to get into our garage from our side door every time it rained. Every time there was a chance of rain I would get anxiety worrying about if our garage was going to flood. Several months ago I paid almost $2k for a different company to hydro jet out the pipes and found out that they had really bad root intrusion and the pipe was basically falling apart. That company (not TSR Trenchless) quoted $30k to rip up our driveway and replace the drain pipes. DIY solutions were not helping the issue so I contacted TSR Trenchless and they relined our pipes (without digging up anything) before a huge storm rolled in! And the best part is they fixed our issue for less than 1/5 of the cost of the other company's quote and offered a better warranty on the work. Bob was very honest about expectations for the project and was very knowledgeable about what was needed for our situation. Our final cost was within the range of the initial quote and Bob's team did the job in a timely manner. My only regret is that I did not call them sooner!

reviews.author: Kathy C.
reviews.body: My plumbing problem needed an immediate solution and Bob at TSR came through with flying colors. My small mixed use (commercial/residential) property needed the sewer line fixed quickly and efficiently and that's exactly what Bob did. I've been through this before with my own home and relied on input from my previous sewer contractor on how to approach the problem and reviewed the TSR quote with him to make sure everything looked fine. My call for help went out to TSR on Thursday around noon and his crew started the job Monday morning and wrapped it up that afternoon as planned. I am very pleased.

reviews.author: Todd J.
reviews.body: Our sewer line (cast iron and clay) had root intrusion and was at the end of its lifetime (70 yrs). After being surprised by the cost of our first quote for lining our system we searched more thoroughly and obtained three more quotes. Two of the four companies provided a thorough overview of what was required. Bob provided a ballpark cost estimate by phone based on our description and visited in person with a sample of what the liner looks like. His phone estimate was very close to the final price, which was significantly less than the other vendors. Bob was very patient in answering our questions in person and remotely prior to installation. Boris did an outstanding job lining our system. It was complete in one day. The only other contender was more expensive and felt the project would take 2-3 days. This was an expensive project, and we wanted it done right the first time. TSR did an excellent job at the lowest price.

reviews.author: Jason M.
reviews.body: My house was built in 1979 and was plagued with root intrusion on a regular basis. I called multiple big name plumbers and kept receiving quotes that were so high to complete the repair that I was forced to keep doing less expensive band aid repairs that just kept putting off the real issue. I finally contacted TSR who not only showed up promptly but were able to give me a quote that was more than half the price of the big name companies. Within the same week of the initial call they came to my house, dug a hole, cleaned out all the root intrusion, relined my pipes, and gave me a twenty year guarantee on the work completed. They showed me video footage of the before and after ensuring my peace of mind that the problem no longer existed. I could not be happier with the results and would recommend them to anyone who is having a sewage drain issue. So glad I found TSR

reviews.author: Chris
reviews.body: Excellent experience with Bob and his crew. Price was several thousands under a name brand plumbing company in San Diego. His guys were awesome. They were punctual, neat and respected plants and property, work was competently and efficiently performed, in and out in 5 hours flat. Don't go to a plumbing company who does everything. TSR specializes in CIPP. I hope we never need them again, but if we do, I'll be calling Bob.

name: CPC Trenchless, LLC
tagline: Trenchless sewer lining and pipe bursting across Texas, led by a hands-on owner
about:
CPC Trenchless is a Texas trenchless sewer contractor owned and run by Shawn Jones. Shawn has been working in trenchless sewer repair for more than ten years, and there isn't much in this trade he hasn't handled firsthand. Cured-in-place pipe lining, pipe bursting, sectional point repairs, lateral reinstatement, camera inspection: he knows the methods, the equipment, and, more importantly, when each one is the right call and when it isn't.

That judgment is what sets CPC Trenchless apart. Shawn's first priority on every job is making sure the customer gets the repair they actually need, done with the most economical and viable solution that will hold up for the long term. If a spot repair will solve the problem, he'll tell you that instead of selling you a full-length liner. If a line is beyond lining, he'll explain why and lay out the options so you can make an informed decision.

Customers describe Shawn the same way again and again: kind, patient, and excellent at his work. He takes the time to walk homeowners and property managers through the camera footage, answer every question in plain language, and explain exactly what the crew is going to do before anyone touches the pipe. A failed sewer line is stressful, and Shawn treats it that way, with respect for the property and the people who live or work there.

He is a hands-on owner, not a name on a truck. Shawn is on the job site, involved in the work, and personally accountable for the result. That reputation for honest assessments and quality workmanship is why CPC Trenchless earns repeat customers and referrals across Houston, Dallas-Fort Worth, San Antonio, Austin, and the rest of Texas.

When you call CPC Trenchless, you're talking to a team led by someone who cares whether your sewer problem is fixed correctly the first time, at a price that makes sense.

name: All Sewer and Plumbing Services, LLC
tagline: Colorado's early adopter of trenchless sewer lining, serving the Denver metro and statewide
about:
All Sewer and Plumbing Services (formerly operating as Sewer Solutions) has offered trenchless sewer rehabilitation across Colorado since 2009, when owner Jeff Haug trained on and purchased Perma-Liner lining equipment at a time when almost no one in the state was offering the technology. The company has since completed hundreds of lining jobs for residential, commercial and industrial customers.

Beyond sewer laterals the crews have lined pool plumbing, storm drains and roof drains, and provide the full trenchless toolkit: camera inspection, hydro-jetting, cured-in-place lining and pipe bursting. Dedicated trenchless trucks and crews run out of the north Denver metro, with most work in the Denver and Boulder areas, and the company will travel anywhere in Colorado for a lining project. Most situations can be assessed over the phone before a free on-site quote.
certifications: Perma-Liner trained; CIPP lining, pipe bursting, hydro-jetting, camera inspection; residential, commercial and industrial.

name: American Trenchless Technologies, Inc.
tagline: 100% trenchless sewer rehabilitation for the greater Chicago area, based in DeKalb
about:
American Trenchless Technologies is owned and operated by Mark Carpenter, who ran a Ben Franklin Plumbing franchise that led the network in trenchless sales for years before founding a company devoted entirely to trenchless work. Based in DeKalb, the company serves Chicago and its suburbs and is one of the most recommended trenchless contractors in northern Illinois.

The work is mostly residential lateral lining, but the crews have completed demanding commercial projects as well. One example: relining all of the piping of a badly deteriorated 1970s swimming pool at a Harry Weese-designed home, shaped like an ear of corn for its original owner, DeKalb Corn, and finishing in time for a family's 80th birthday party. The company has invested in current lining machines, high-pressure jetters and video inspection equipment and runs experienced crews for complex jobs.
certifications: CIPP lining, hydro-jetting, sewer camera inspection; residential and commercial; former Ben Franklin Plumbing franchise owner-operator.

name: Fletch Barney Trenchless, LLC
tagline: Georgia's first trenchless sewer contractor, since 1995
about:
Alan Fletcher started his full-service plumbing company in 1991 and in 1995 became the first contractor in Georgia to offer trenchless sewer and drain rehabilitation. Thirty years on, Fletch Barney is regularly called in by engineers to consult on difficult sewer infrastructure designs and repairs, and to train other contractors on the technology.

The company is one of a small number in North America cleared to perform trenchless and plumbing work inside nuclear facilities, a credential that involves stringent background checks and requirements. For homeowners the approach is the same as for engineers: assess the line with a camera, explain the options plainly, and recommend the most economical fix, whether that is a cleaning, a camera inspection or a full lining.
certifications: Trenchless sewer and drain rehabilitation since 1995; consultant and trainer to engineers and contractors; cleared for work inside U.S. nuclear facilities.
